home.title: Welcome to DoofPlus
home.content: Manage batch traceability, quality events and regulatory evidence of your pharmaceutical laboratory in one place.

traceability.title: Batch traceability

monitoring.description: Track production status and quality alerts as they happen.

audit.title: Audit readiness
audit.description: Keep an immutable audit trail and generate regulatory reports.

workflow.title: From batch to release
workflow.description: DoofPlus supports the daily quality workflow of your laboratory.

items.2: Review and approve with electronic signatures.
items.3: Release the batch with complete evidence.
